what: One-off setup for the GKE runs (k8s/gke/up.sh), and the list prices used for cost estimates
gpu_quota_note: The project's GPU quota is 1 across all regions; A100/H100 quota is 0, so 1x NVIDIA L4 is the largest GPU available to it.

list_prices_usd_per_hour.source: Cloud Billing Catalog API (Compute Engine SKUs, us-central1, on-demand unless noted), fetched 2026-09-14
list_prices_usd_per_hour.derivation: g2-standard-8 = 8 vCPU x core + 32 GiB x ram + 1 L4; e2-standard-4 = 4 vCPU x core + 16 GiB x ram. Spot uses the Spot SKUs (G2 core 0.01499, G2 ram 0.001756, L4 0.336). Excludes the GKE cluster management fee and Cloud Build minutes.
